d:
This one has been on my list for a while. Honestly, I was kind of hoping a real translator would pick it up before I could, and kept deliberately kicking the can down the road. Genesis does such a fantastic job making everything looks soft and squishy.

I probably won't be able to hold back next time, though. I've seen the previews for his C108 book, and it looks really damn good. While I'm waiting on that, though, I'm going to go do another chapter of youkai inn.

I tried to get more fancy with the fonts this time, especially as the raw had different fonts for each speaker, and I try to take my cues from the raw for stylistic decisions. Do let me know if it worked out.

You can find the raw here:

https://e-hentai.org/g/3730866/a284499eb8/
